The screen has a quick entry labelled 'Title' and a list of books, newest first.

package.app.yaml:
contract_version: "0.2"
app_id: "reading-list"
name: "Reading list"
description: "Add books by title, see them newest first, and mark one as finished."
runtime_profile: "pyprof-391f9ca6e9db5bc54576"
sdk_version: "0.1.0"
capabilities: [records]
collections:
  - name: books
    description: One book on the reading list.
    fields:
      - {name: title, kind: text, required: true, max_length: 200}
      - {name: finished, kind: boolean, required: true}
    indexes: [[finished]]
actions:
  - id: add_book
    title: Add a book
    description: Add one book to the reading list, not finished yet.
    handler: app_code.handlers:add_book
    invocable_from: [ui, manual]
    effect_class: local_write
    capability_requirements: [records]
    timeout_seconds: 30
    retry_class: pure
    input_schema:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties: {title: {type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 200}}
    output_schema:
      type: object
      required: [id, revision]
      properties: {id: {type: string}, revision: {type: integer}}
  - id: finish_book
    title: Mark a book finished
    description: Mark one book on the reading list as finished.
    handler: app_code.handlers:finish_book
    invocable_from: [ui, manual]
    effect_class: local_write
    capability_requirements: [records]
    timeout_seconds: 30
    retry_class: idempotent
    input_schema:
      type: object
      required: [id]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties: {id: {type: string, minLength: 1}}
    output_schema:
      type: object
      required: [id, revision]
      properties: {id: {type: string}, revision: {type: integer}}
ui:
  entry: ui/src/main.tsx
  build_profile: "uiprof-5a3bad2e0741affeb06b"
  kit_version: "0.1.0"
  bridge_version: "0.2.0"
  views:
    - id: books.recent
      collection: books
      fields: [title, finished]
      filterable: [finished]
      sortable: [title, created_at]
      default_order: [{field: created_at, direction: desc}]
      max_limit: 100
  actions: [add_book, finish_book]
